name: Ricki Ruiz

bio.statement: His official biography calls him one of Oregon's youngest state legislators.
bio.excerpt: one of Oregon's youngest state legislators.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Ruiz member page

bio.statement: His official biography says he was elected to the Reynolds School District board in 2017.
bio.excerpt: youngest school board member in Reynolds School District

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Ruiz member page

bio.statement: His campaign site says he was raised in Gresham and was the first in his family to graduate from high school.
bio.excerpt: Ricki was the first member of his family to graduate from high school

positions.statement: His campaign priorities page says addressing the rising cost of living is a priority, including reducing utility costs and supporting childcare assistance.
positions.excerpt: I will work to reduce utility costs and support programs that provide childcare assistance.

positions.statement: His priorities page says improving public safety in Gresham and Oregon is crucial.
positions.excerpt: Supporting and improving public safety in Gresham and Oregon is crucial

positions.statement: His priorities page says he will prioritize housing and homelessness, including expanding affordable housing and supportive services.
positions.excerpt: expanding affordable housing developments, increasing funding for supportive services

positions.statement: His priorities page says he will prioritize addressing substance addiction through treatment and mental health services.
positions.excerpt: expanding access to comprehensive treatment programs and mental health services

positions.statement: His priorities page says he will advocate for equitable, quality education from early childhood to higher education.
positions.excerpt: I will advocate for equitable and quality education, from early childhood to higher education.
